description: This file contains unit tests for the `BasketWithItemsSpecification` class, including tests that verify matching baskets based on basket ID or buyer ID, along with mock data setup.

classes.name: BasketWithItems
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the `BasketWithItemsSpecification`, testing matching baskets based on ID or buyer ID, using mocks.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBasketId
methods.description: Tests that the specification matches a basket with a specific ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBasketIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that the specification does not match any baskets when a non-existing basket ID is used.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBuyerId
methods.description: Tests that the specification matches a basket with a specific buyer ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBuyerIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that the specification does not match any baskets when a non-existing buyer ID is used.

methods.name: GetTestBasketCollection
methods.description: Creates and returns a mock collection of baskets with predefined IDs and BuyerId, used in test evaluations.
